summary: Canonical boot opening owner. All 37 functions, 21,272 text bytes, four owned sections, and 1,928 relocations are exact; the linked boot REL and main DOL are retail-identical. Five data objects now have narrow consumer-derived proposed names, one unreferenced BSS object has an explicitly non-semantic name, and no address-derived identifier remains in opening.c. One duplicated 16-bit initialized stack slot is target-backed, while its original name, signedness, and semantics remain unknown.

evidence.summary: The relocation-aware owner comparison reports 37 of 37 exact functions, 21,272 exact text bytes, 448 exact rodata bytes, 873 exact data bytes, 478 exact BSS bytes, and all 1,928 target relocations.
The serialized build reproduces retail bootDll.rel and main.dol byte-for-byte, and the DTK project checksum validates all configured outputs.

Retail SwapAnimFrameEvent and openingDll fn_1_4744 are the same 104-byte instruction template apart from owner-specific relocation targets. Both spill two 32-bit arguments, initialize one otherwise unread 16-bit slot at stack offset 16, sleep five frames, and install the indexed animation. This authenticates the initialized-slot shape but not its signedness, name, or purpose.

SwapAnimFrame passes only the animation and frame indices through EventCreate. The directed owner graph and direct target calls expose no third value or consumer that could authenticate semantics for the initialized slot.

Three embedded object-name strings are consumed directly by Hu3DAnimCreate or Hu3DModelObjPtrGet, and two GXColor objects feed FilterDraw's two TEV color registers. Their proposed names describe those exact roles without claiming original spellings. OpeningUnusedBss is unreferenced and explicitly non-semantic.

The scratch spelling and prior volatile qualifier were introduced by recovery commits, and openingDll's matching scratch spelling was also recovery-created. They are not original-name or type provenance.

debt.summary: The target proves an initialized 16-bit slot but cannot recover its original identifier. The source uses the explicitly non-semantic name unused rather than inventing a role.
The emitted store proves 16-bit width only. Signedness is not observable because the value is never read; retain that uncertainty instead of treating the current typedef as semantic evidence.
The owner requires pool data to be disabled in its narrow configure.py object profile. Removing that mode regresses text and function exactness despite leaving literal sections exact.

DATA_title ownership is authenticated, but archive-entry and sound-catalog names are unavailable. Resource indices use DATANUM(DATA_title, index), while message, animation, and sound constants remain deliberately generic and owner-local.
The five cleaned data names are behavior-derived proposals, not recovered original spellings. OpeningUnusedBss records only that the configured BSS object has no consumer.
